author: 450esrat

title: Worth it
text: Great tour that shows you some of Barcelonas landmarks.  It’s a great way to get your bearings of Barcelona to start exploring the city on your own.  Thank you for a fun day.
author: Raelene_M

title: Fun way to see Barcelona
text: Great way to see the beautiful city.  We met our guide, Simon, at his small shop tucked away in an alley of the gothic quarter, chose e-bikes or scooters and headed out for an amazing tour.  Lots of fun and a great way to see parts of Barcelona that we wouldn’t have seen.  Highly recommend this 2 1/2 hour tour.
author: Cabana4Us

title: Blast
text: Our tour guide was exceptional.  We had a great time!!! Highly recommended. You get to see so much in just a couple of hours.

title: Recommended!
